_comment: Role → file mapping and default mixing parameters for FlowCast.

intro.description: Played at the very beginning of the bulletin, before any vocal clip.

outro.description: Played at the end of the bulletin, after the last vocal clip.

fond.description: Background music looped or ducked under vocal clips throughout the bulletin.

transition.description: Short jingle inserted between vocal clips.

defaults._duck_db_comment: Background music ducking level in dB (relative to full volume).
defaults._transition_max_ms_comment: Maximum transition clip length in milliseconds.
defaults._transition_fade_in_ms_comment: Fade-in duration applied to the transition clip (ms).
defaults._transition_fade_out_ms_comment: Fade-out duration applied to the transition clip (ms).
defaults._silence_thresh_db_relative_comment: Silence threshold expressed in dB relative to the mean dBFS of the clip.
defaults._min_silence_len_ms_comment: Minimum silence length (ms) to be considered a real pause.
defaults._min_gap_safety_ms_comment: Safety margin (ms) kept before and after detected speech boundaries.
